summary: Submitted a repeat of fixed experiment 7db8c9fb0d794b08892b9349c54fa466-experiment, the harness for the configuration-recovery account's multi-node observations. The account's newest claim - that a node recovering with no configuration never attempts candidacy while the same node and log with the replay disabled do, sampled over a 1500ms window - rests on a single execution, and that harness also contains the three-voter commit-rule case, the durable-snapshot case and the availability case. The rationale states the reproduction question explicitly: whether the authority pair returns the same split (zero candidate samples for the empty-configuration node, candidacy for the recovered one) and whether the commit-rule, durable-snapshot and availability operands come back unchanged in a fresh clean copy. The repeat consumes one execution; its receipt will be cited in that account if a further turn is granted.
